environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application on PHP-FPM 8.2 with pcntl enabled, deployed on EKS 1.28. The namespace has a Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy with a default-deny egress posture. An additional CiliumNetworkPolicy object (metadata name: restrict-link-local) specifies spec.egress with a toCIDR of 0.0.0.0/0 and toCIDRSet entries that include a cidrGroupRef for internal services, but critically includes an 'except' clause under toCIDRSet listing 169.254.0.0/16 which covers the entire link-local range. The policy also has a denyAtIngress annotation for metadata.google.internal DNS resolution. The Cilium agent runs in strict mode with policy enforcement set to 'always' and endpoint status shows the policy is realized on the pod's endpoint. Additionally, kube-dns CoreDNS has a rewrite rule that NXDOMAINs queries for metadata.google.internal from this namespace.
